notes.title: The Narrator Is A Dick : Longer, Harder, and Uncut OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25211930/75f26dfd5f5ed72623a116f5ecdfbab3de4202d5.png[/img]

View the new game here  : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275770/The_Narrator_is_a_DICK__Longer_Harder_and_Uncut/

[previewyoutube=ISUo0mf_xTI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Everyone, 

The Narrator is a DICK : Longer, Harder, and Uncut is available now! 

[u][b]If you owned the original game you will receive this game for free.[/b][/u]

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Comedy Based Unfair 2D Platformer - Inspired by Games Like "I Wanna Be The Guy" and "Kaizo Mario".
[*]Fully Voiced - Every Line is Fully Voiced in English.
[*]A Cavalcade Of Crazy Characters - Meet Zany and Wild Characters as you Travel.
[*]Full Controller Support - Play using Keyboard or Controller.
[*]Steam Achievements - An Assortment of Achievements to Unlock.
[*]Improved Gameplay - Overall the game just feels better and smoother to play.
[*]Multiplayer - Play every level together with your friends in rooms of up to 144 players.
[*]Time Trial - Speed runners rejoice as your time played is now tracked in-game, making it easy to decide who is truly the best.
[*]Original Soundtrack - A brand new original OST by Kirk Markarian.
[*]Improved Graphics - New and Improved Sprites.
[*]Infinite Save Slots - Start a New Game Without Losing Progress in Others.
[*]Improved UI - Better Looking and More Uniform UI Elements.
[*]Subtitles - Subtitles to Improve Accessibility.
[*]New SFX - New and Improved Sound Effects.
[*]Animations - New and Improved Animations.
[*]Details - New and Improved Level Details.
[/list]
Please let me know what your thoughts are on this or if you have any questions, as well as any additions or changes you'd like to suggest. Thanks, and I hope to see you guys in-game soon.

See you guys soon 👍
-Adam

notes.title: The Narrator Is A Dick : Longer, Harder, and Uncut Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25211930/75f26dfd5f5ed72623a116f5ecdfbab3de4202d5.png[/img]

Please wishlist the new game here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275770/The_Narrator_is_a_DICK__Longer_Harder_and_Uncut/

[previewyoutube=ISUo0mf_xTI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Everyone, 

When I created the original The Narrator Is A Dick it was only my second game ever. While the reception of the game was generally very positive, and it received a great deal of online buzz I've always felt that it could have been an even better game. For that reason I am excited to announce that I have begun working on a remastered edition of this title [u]The Narrator Is A Dick : Longer, Harder, and Uncut[/u]. 

[u][b]Everyone who owns a copy of the original game prior to the remastered edition being released will receive the remaster for FREE.[/b][/u]

These are the key features of the remaster that are complete, or near completion as of today.

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Gameplay[/b] - Overall the game just feels better and smoother to play.
[*] [b]Multiplayer [/b]- Play every level together with your friends in rooms of up to 144 players.
[*] [b]Unlockable Characters[/b] - Play as any NPC in the game (Including the Unicorn).
[*] [b]Time Trial[/b] - Speed runners rejoice as your time played is now tracked in-game, making it easy to decide who is truly the best.
[*] [b]Original Soundtrack[/b] - A brand new original OST.
[*] [b]Improved Graphics[/b] - Several of the original sprites we're low quality or blurry. They have either been fixed or replaced.
[*] [b]Infinite Save Slots[/b] - The original game had only 1 save slot. Now you can create as many as your computer can hold.
[*] [b]Improved UI[/b] - Better looking and more uniform UI elements.
[*] [b]Subtitles [/b]- Subtitles to improve access for the hearing impaired.
[*] [b]New SFX[/b] - New sound effects have been added, and some old ones have been improved.
[*] [b]Animations [/b]- Deaths look and feel much more pleasing as your character flies through the air upon death.
[*] [b]Details [/b]- More details per level. Things like trees, grass, effects, ect.
[/list]

Please let me know what your thoughts are on this or if you have any questions, as well as any additions or changes you'd like to suggest. Thanks, and I hope to see you guys in-game soon.

- Adam

notes.title: Update 1.2 Released.
notes.notes:
Update 1.2 

Partial Controller Support. 
Updated Audio in some locations. 
Invincibility frames increased to .5 seconds (Up from .25). 
Desert Vultures health pool reduced to 2 (Down from 4). 
Difficulty curve for World 1-4 adjusted to be more in line with the rest of the game. 
New audio clip upon unlocking a character.

notes.title: Controller Support Incoming
notes.notes:
Hey guys thanks for the positive support, just wanted to let you know that yesterday I rewrote the controls to Blaster Shooter GunGuy! Using a script that I wrote for my new game "The Narrator is a D*CK". This new script allows for full controller support. I'm currently in the process of remaking the menu's for GunGuy! To allow use of a controller, once that's done the update will be released. You can expect it to drop around the time of the Christmas sale, and GunGuy will receive an 80-90% discount to correspond with the update. 

If you'd like to keep updated with what I'm doing you can follow me here 

https://twitter.com/AdamDeLease

Thanks everyone!
